messages.content:
需求：前后端：page_size 默认值由 20 改为 25，上限由 50 改为 100。响应新增整数 page、page_size，回显实际生效值。

持续有效约束：page 缺省 1，旧 skip/limit 仍禁止；page_size=100 成功、101 失败。前端以回显值同步控件。

本次变更事实：
[FACT:request-page-size-maximum] request.page_size.maximum = 100
[FACT:request-page-size-default] request.page_size.default = 25
[FACT:response-page-type] response.page.type = "integer"
[FACT:response-page-value] response.page.value = "effective_page"
[FACT:response-page-size-type] response.page_size.type = "integer"
[FACT:response-page-size-value] response.page_size.value = "effective_page_size"

当前契约事实：
[FACT:request-invalid-status] (frontend,backend; derivable) request.invalid_status = 422
[FACT:response-count-scope] (frontend,backend; derivable) response.count.scope = "authorized_filtered_before_pagination"
[FACT:response-empty-page-data] (frontend,backend; derivable) response.empty_page.data = []
[FACT:request-skip-accepted] (frontend,backend; derivable) request.skip.accepted = false
[FACT:request-limit-accepted] (frontend,backend; derivable) request.limit.accepted = false
[FACT:request-page-type] (frontend,backend; derivable) request.page.type = "integer"
[FACT:request-page-minimum] (frontend,backend; derivable) request.page.minimum = 1
[FACT:request-page-default] (frontend,backend; derivable) request.page.default = 1
[FACT:request-page-size-type] (frontend,backend; derivable) request.page_size.type = "integer"
[FACT:request-page-size-minimum] (frontend,backend; derivable) request.page_size.minimum = 1
[FACT:request-page-size-maximum] (frontend,backend; must_be_explicit) request.page_size.maximum = 100
[FACT:request-page-size-default] (frontend,backend; must_be_explicit) request.page_size.default = 25
[FACT:pagination-offset] (frontend,backend; derivable) pagination.offset = "(page-1)*page_size"
[FACT:response-page-type] (frontend,backend; must_be_explicit) response.page.type = "integer"
[FACT:response-page-value] (frontend,backend; must_be_explicit) response.page.value = "effective_page"
[FACT:response-page-size-type] (frontend,backend; must_be_explicit) response.page_size.type = "integer"
[FACT:response-page-size-value] (frontend,backend; must_be_explicit) response.page_size.value = "effective_page_size"
